title: Lena and the Machine
author: Bram Hartwell
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
